_format: Agent-authored executive summaries. sections keyed by section id; entries keyed by repo-relative path. Value: {text, basedOn}. text: 2-3 sentences, <=320 chars, factual — topic, scale, tech.

aws.text: First-generation AWS certification study tools: an MCQ practice engine over ~5,300 questions in 11 datasets and a services glossary with type-in quiz mode. Also holds raw PDF-extraction artifacts (1,292 images, 1,725 tables) not wired into the UI.

aws2.text: Second-generation AWS Study Kit for CLF-C02, AIF-C01 and SAA-C03: 141 comparison tables, 719 glossary entries and 122 annotated figures in a combined browser, a KB viewer (153 tables), visual SAA-C03 guides and a 745-question practice engine (+205 AIF-C01). Inter font, themes, localStorage bookmarks.

bcf.text: Two drafts of the BCF competition whitepaper for the DeepMind/Kaggle Gemma 4 Agent Competition: specification-driven graph reasoning for autonomous SWE agents on gemma-4-31b, plus the BCF-SWE-Python taxonomy of 129 human-verified repair tasks. Draft 02 reframes draft 01's measured claims as expected results.

bleum.text: ChronoSync zoomable timelines in PixiJS v8 (WebGPU/canvas). DUKR landing (bleum/3) serves four subjects — Beyoncé v2.0.1 (150 events, 1981–2026), Drake v1.3.2 (172), Musk v1.3.1 (175), Kendrick v1.6.4 (129) — via a config-driven orbit menu with 12 background presets; legacy viewers in bleum/1–2.

bsh.text: Canvas2D physics stacking game (12.5k lines, level editor, themed materials). Features two unified reader collections: 26 docs in docs/ (25 AI model implementation plans for a Unity clone plus a 65-category FOSS shortlist) and 3 docs in docs2/ covering multi-screen systems and an 8-topic architecture consolidation.

cvx.text: Research hub: 386 markdown docs across 13 reader collections, kaggle3/kaggle4 BCF hubs, VoterLens + Civic Radar playgrounds, and a 144-source debate guide. kaggle4 hosts 138 documents (131 md, 7 html) in six Gemma-4 packs; kaggle3 spans twelve packs incl. the 11-25 Gemini gap analysis and brain v2.

da.text: Single-page showcase of the 19 winners of the DeepAgent AI-powered-app competition, each with a screenshot carousel and description. Purple-gradient background with white rounded cards.

deliverables.text: Master archive of project deliverables: 279 markdown docs across 41 folders (40 dated + _misc), 10 entry pages, and standalone SPAs. Spans BCF v2 tuning/bottleneck playbooks, 2 DUKR voting-app reader collections (marked.js), DukrNews Vanilla/Svelte 5 kinetic navigators, FOSS explorers, and civic screener UI suites.

demo.text: CVX Splash — the visual identity experiments: 38 animated background and particle studies across clouds, ocean, abyss, constellation and particle families, built with canvas 2D, WebGL shaders, PixiJS and Babylon.js. Includes references like the pixijs.com header recreation.

devh.text: Client-side viewers over scraped DevHunt.org product listings dated 2026-02-28: 818 products in the full viewer and 206 with live previews. Search, tag filter, and sort over fetched static JSON files.

dukr.text: DUKR hub: MVP promo pages, AtariVault 2600 GPU grids (WebGL2, PixiJS v8/RBush), Kevin Hart tracker (129 articles), and 11 FOSS/GitHub JSON explorers — including 10,115-repo (431 videos) & 7,140-repo (457 videos) showcases, 8,903-product (69 cats) & 2,928-tool (79 cats) category browsers, and 4,351-tool index.

exam.text: Focused AWS Cloud Practitioner exam simulator: 65 questions / 90 minutes, domain-weighted selection (26/25/33/16%), per-question timers, review tab with time statistics and export. Draws from a 5,252-question pool mirrored from the gen-1 datasets.

fs.text: Heavy single-file media archive showcases: 3,413 coderprog posts (fs/), 3,070 0daydown items (fs/1), and a 50,848-entry prizrak catalog (fs/1b) embedded as gzip+base64 and JSON blobs. Browsable via virtualized table and card grids with cover previews, filters, and bookmark export in a 13px dark terminal aesthetic.

gjl.text: GJL Consulting LLC's real business website: five consulting services, testimonials, discovery-call booking and payment methods (PayPal/Venmo/Cash App/Zelle). Inter + Playfair Display, the only conventional multi-page site in the repo.

md.text: Markdown library of ten curated repository catalogs — RAG/memory systems, frontend UI kits, LLM training, browser automation and more. Documents open in the unified reader (/reader/?src=md/items) with table of contents, full-text search and prev/next, rendered via marked.js, DOMPurify and Prism.

md-dxc.text: Internal work documentation library: payroll/HR incident write-ups, eTES SQL patch plans and requirement docs. Read in the unified reader (/reader/?src=md-dxc/items) with table of contents, full-text search and prev/next navigation.

mdh.text: Eleven pre-rendered AWS/AI-security study pages: CLF-C02 guides, well-architected pillars, exam notes. Served by the unified reader (/reader/?src=mdh/items) with table of contents, full-text search and prev/next navigation.

money.text: Investor watchlist dashboards: a 132-ticker 2026 DRAM shortage thesis board and a 122-ticker IoT/sensors/physical-AI board, each with supply-chain and glossary tabs, sentiment filters and JSON export.

ph.text: Self-contained Product Hunt viewers over embedded JSON catalogs: 229,971 merged launches (Jan–Nov 2026, 428 topics) in compact-v3 format, 8,449 launches (Jan–May), 1,337-item FOSS roundup (Jan–Sep), plus 3 archived snapshots. Virtualized card/table views, month chips, tag filters, favorites, and export.

scam.text: ScamShield venture documentation: model system prompts, deployment guides (Railway/Render), go-live checklist, test plan, pitch prep and video storyboards — 29 markdown docs. Read in the unified reader (/reader/?src=scam/items) with table of contents, full-text search and prev/next.

showcase.text: Offline local launchpad (single-page HTML/CSS, Inter & JetBrains Mono) indexing civic intelligence assets via local file links: 2 standalone SPA playgrounds (VoterLens, Civic Radar), 4 cvx/ research collections (Michigan Senate, 50-state Voter Resources, Economic Indicators, Gov Data Inventory), and main portal.

ur.text: Browser over 13,983 Google Play reviews of the Bluesky app: full-text search, star filters, five sort orders, date ranges and developer responses. Frosted-glass cards on a purple gradient.
